newsitem.title: DUBAI: JULY DUBAI AIR CARGO VOLUMES UP 17.7 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: JULY DUBAI AIR CARGO VOLUMES UP 17.7 PERCENT.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 17.7 percent in July to 35,000 tonnes from 29,739 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.
Exports rose 13.6 percent from July last year to 16,550 tonnes, and imports moved up 21.6 percent to 18,451 tonnes. The figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Trans-shipments in the month totalled 7,338 tonnes, a 45 percent increase on July 1996's figure.
Courier and mail volumes dropped two percent to 801 tonnes.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. - Dubai newsroom +9714 - 626990 - www.racs.com
